facts.fact: The Namibian National Assembly's gazette notice invites applications for Information Commissioner and Deputy under regulations on the selection committee and appointment process published as Government Notice No. 380 of 9 December 2024, made under the Access to Information Act, 2022.

NAM.note: Document is about the Information Commissioner recruitment; says nothing on local government connection.
Document states nothing on an open data policy.
Document states nothing on published open data.
Document states nothing on schools or internet.
